text:
Emily: FYI I'm starting a dry-run enable for catalog model `cascade-v3` in canary this afternoon (2% traffic) to validate telemetry and fallback behavior. DeployBot will run the dry traffic job at 17:30 PT.

DeployBot: queued dry-run job `dryrun-cascade-v3-3223344556` -> scheduled 2026-03-21T17:30:00-07:00. Use `deploybot status <job>` for updates.

Raj: quick Q — what's the explicit fallback ordering for this dry-run? we need deterministic ladder for the canary so autoscaling & cost estimates are stable.

Emily: fallback ladder for the run is: `cascade-v3` -> pinned `cascade-v2@2026-03-01` -> `fallback-small-1.1`. TTL for KV cache sticky pins is 10m for this test.

Marta: release notes? I want to include a short ops blurb and the change-window in the customer-facing doc.

Emily: added a shortline in the internal release note draft: https://go/redwood/release-notes/cascade-v3-dryrun (internal). Change window: 17:30-18:30 PT, monitoring hold at 17:45.

Owen: rollback triggers? please be explicit. If latency p95 increases > 200ms vs baseline or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, we auto-rollback. Also manual rollback if hallucination regressions show up on eval set.

Emily: agreed. Configured thresholds in the canary job: `p95_delta_ms:200`, `error_rate_pct:0.5`, `sustained_minutes:5`. I added the eval prompt suite run after 10k requests.

Raj: how are we handling version pinning across Dedicated tenants during this dry-run? don't want pin shuffle surprises in prod.

Emily: no tenant-level pins will change. This is catalog routing only for hosted canary. Dedicated customers remain on their pinned versions. We'll update the pinlist in `catalog-pinlist` only if dry-run passes and after a separate commit.

DeployBot: dry-run job `dryrun-cascade-v3-3223344556` started. Samples: 200 test requests/min, telemetry sink: `obs.cascade.v3.dryrun`. Logs go to `/var/log/deploybot/dryrun-3223344556.log`.

SRE-Bot: basic infra checks: node groups healthy, GPU mem headroom 18%, quorum OK. No alerts currently.

Marta: can we get a short telemetry checklist here so I can paste in the ops blurb?

Emily: checklist pasted below:
- confirm `obs` stream healthy and dashboard populates within 2m
- check `p95_latency`, `error_rate`, `vm_cpu`, `kv_cache_hit`
- eval-run results (sanity prompts) after 10k requests
- canary heatmap: region breakdown + fallback events

Owen: will watch the metrics during the hold. If fallback events > 1 per minute for 3m, we pause and investigate.

Raj: if we need rollback, who calls the rollback? Ops or Release lead?

Emily: Release lead (me) will call the rollback; Ops to execute the rollback (DeployBot command). We'll do a quick consensus on the thread with :thumbsup: from Ops and SRE before triggering, unless it meets the auto-rollback thresholds.

DeployBot: rollback command (manual) -> `deploybot rollback catalog cascade-v3 --dryrun-job dryrun-cascade-v3-3223344556`

Marta: noted. I'll draft the customer-facing blurb with the observed changes and link to the canary dashboard.

Emily: thanks — ping me if anything spikes. I'll open a follow-up thread for post-dryrun decisions (pinlist update / staged enable) once we have 30m of steady metrics.

Owen: :thumbsup:

Raj: :thumbsup:

Marta: :thumbsup:

DeployBot: dry-run job heartbeat: 10m elapsed, 4% traffic processed, no auto-rollback conditions met.
